title: Coherent higher-image fibre-dimension bound for proper algebraic spaces
statement: Let $Y$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth], and let $p:Z\to Y$ be a proper morphism of algebraic spaces [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Proper means separated, of finite type and universally closed, with the algebraic-space conventions of [lem-sfb-space-flat-proper-fp-locality]. Let $d\geq0$ be an integer. Assume that every geometric fibre $Z\times_Y\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$, for every algebraically closed field $\Omega$ and map $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y$, has dimension at most $d$. Dimension is the supremum of Krull dimensions on affine etale charts, with empty fibre of dimension $-\infty$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Let $F$ be a coherent module on the small etale site of $Z$: $F$ is quasi-coherent [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module], and there is a jointly surjective family of etale maps $\operatorname{Spec}B_k\to Z$ from affine schemes with each $B_k$ a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] such that the restriction of $F$ to $\operatorname{Spec}B_k$ is associated to a finitely generated $B_k$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] (quasi-coherent of finite type, tested on one etale cover). Then $R^qp_*F=0$ for every integer $q>d$. Higher direct images are the right derived functors of module direct image on small etale ringed sites, computed by injective resolutions in all module sheaves [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. No flatness of $p$ is required.

source.place: Tag 0A4T (lemma-higher-direct-images-zero-above-dimension-fibre), applied at every geometric point; empty fibres give zero stalks.

proof.text: Fix $q>d$ and a geometric point $\bar y:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y$ with $\Omega$ algebraically closed. Apply [lem-sfb-space-formal-functions-geometric-stalk] to $p,F,\bar y,q$. It supplies the Noetherian local ring $A=\mathcal O_{Y,\bar y}$, its maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$, the spaces $Z_n$, modules $F_n$ and the comparison $\widehat M\simeq\varprojlim_n H^q(Z_n,F_n)$, for $M=(R^qp_*F)_{\bar y}$. On the surjective etale scheme chart $\coprod_k\operatorname{Spec}B_k\to Z$ the module $F$ is of finite type, since each restriction is associated to a finitely generated $B_k$-module. By [lem-sfb-space-qcoh-affine-chart-calculus] finite type can be tested on that chart, so on every affine etale chart $\operatorname{Spec}R\to Z$ the quasi-coherent $F$ is the module sheaf associated to the finitely generated $R$-module $F(\operatorname{Spec}R)$: this is the every-chart coherence of [lem-sfb-space-proper-coherent-higher-images], which therefore gives that $R^qp_*F$ is coherent. Its finite local generators give finite generators of $M$ over $A$: take a finite generating presentation on an affine etale neighbourhood of $\bar y$ and take germs; locally lifted sections generate every germ. Thus $M$ is finite. Both inputs apply to algebraic spaces and module direct images, with exactly the properness, locally Noetherian base and coherent-module hypotheses here.

source.place: Tag 0A4T proof, formal-functions notation and coherence of the higher image; Tags 08B1, 08AR

proof.text: Put $k=A/\mathfrak m$ and choose an algebraic closure $K$ of $k$. By [lem-sfb-space-flat-proper-fp-locality], each $Z_n\to\operatorname{Spec}(A/\mathfrak m^n)$ and $Z_1\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is proper. In particular these total spaces are quasi-compact and separated, hence quasi-separated: the bases are affine, and each absolute diagonal factors through its relative diagonal followed by the base change of the affine base diagonal. Both are closed immersions on scheme tests (quotient ideals add under composition). The fibre $(Z_1)_K$ is a geometric fibre of $p$ covered by the hypothesis. Use [lem-sfb-space-etale-atlas-topological-dimension] to read its chartwise dimension bound as $\dim|(Z_1)_K|\leq d$: a quasi-compact scheme atlas can be refined by finitely many affine charts, each having dimension at most $d$. The topological dimension of their finite disjoint union is their maximum, since an irreducible closed subset lies in one summand. Apply [lem-sfb-space-field-extension-dimension] to the separated finite-type $k$-space $Z_1$. It gives $\dim|Z_1|=\dim|(Z_1)_K|\leq d$. This explicitly accounts for the possibly non-algebraically-closed residue field of the etale local ring.

source.place: Tag 0A4T proof, fibre X_1; Tag 04NS for the residue-field extension and Tags 0A4H/0A4J for chart dimension

proof.text: For each $n\geq1$, the closed immersion $\operatorname{Spec}k\hookrightarrow\operatorname{Spec}(A/\mathfrak m^n)$ is a thickening: its defining ideal $\mathfrak m/\mathfrak m^n$ has zero $n$th power, so every prime contains it, and the closed-subspace spectrum topology is unchanged. Apply [lem-sfb-space-thickening-base-change] to its pullback along $Z_n\to\operatorname{Spec}(A/\mathfrak m^n)$. The pullback is $Z_1\hookrightarrow Z_n$, and induces a homeomorphism $|Z_1|\simeq|Z_n|$. A homeomorphism gives a length-preserving bijection between chains of irreducible closed subsets, so $\dim|Z_n|=\dim|Z_1|\leq d$. This also covers empty fibres: all these point spaces are then empty.

source.place: Tag 0A4T proof, equality of underlying topological spaces of the infinitesimal neighbourhoods

proof.text: Each $F_n=i_n^*F$ is quasi-coherent: $F$ is quasi-coherent and tensor pullback along any morphism of algebraic spaces preserves quasi-coherence, with no flatness hypothesis [lem-sfb-space-module-pullback-quasicoherent]. Step 2 gives quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness of $Z_n$, and step 3 gives its dimension bound. Consequently [lem-sfb-space-qcoh-vanishing-above-dimension] applies to $Z_n,F_n,d$ and gives $H^q(Z_n,F_n)=0$ for every $n$, since $q>d$. No flatness of $F$ or $p$ has been used.

source.place: Tag 0A4T proof, application of Tag 0A4R(1) to the pullback modules

proof.text: The inverse limit of the zero groups $H^q(Z_n,F_n)$ is zero: a compatible tuple has every coordinate zero. Hence the comparison of [lem-sfb-space-formal-functions-geometric-stalk] gives $\widehat M=\varprojlim_n M/\mathfrak m^nM=0$.

source.place: Tag 0A4T proof, vanishing of the completed stalk

proof.text: The projection $\widehat M\to M/\mathfrak mM$ is surjective: starting with any class in $M/\mathfrak mM$, choose recursively a lift through each surjection $M/\mathfrak m^{n+1}M\twoheadrightarrow M/\mathfrak m^nM$, obtaining a compatible tuple. Since $\widehat M=0$, this quotient is zero, so $\mathfrak mM=M$. The module $M$ is finite by step 1 and $\mathfrak m$ is the Jacobson radical of the local ring $A$. Nakayama [lem-weil-pbc-nakayama-jacobson] therefore gives $M=0$. This spells out the completion-reflection argument without assuming that reduction to the fibre commutes with higher direct images.

source.place: Tag 0A4T proof, final finite-module completion argument; algebra.tex Tag 00DV(2)

proof.text: The geometric point was arbitrary, so the underlying abelian etale sheaf of $R^qp_*F$ has all geometric stalks zero. Apply [lemma-weil-pbc-geometric-stalk-conservative] to the morphism from the zero abelian sheaf to this underlying sheaf. Every stalk map is an isomorphism; hence the sheaf itself is zero. Its module sheaf is therefore zero as well. This holds for every $q>d$, giving the assertion.

source.place: Tag 0A4T applied at all geometric points; etale-cohomology.tex Tag 03PU

lean.statement: theorem higherDirectImage_isZero_above_geometricFibreDimension (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (Z : AlgebraicSpace Y) (p : Z ⟶ schemeSpace (Over.mk (𝟙 Y))) (hp : MapIsProper p) (d : ℕ) (hdim : ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (y : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ Y) (U : Over Y) (a : yoneda.obj U ⟶ Limits.pullback p.hom.hom (yoneda.map (Over.homMk y : Over.mk y ⟶ Over.mk (𝟙 Y)))), IsEtale a → IsAffine U.left → topologicalKrullDim U.left ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) (F : Z.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (hcoh : ∃ (ι : Type w) (T : ι → Z.EtaleSite), IsJointlySurjective (fun k : ι ↦ (T k).obj.hom) ∧ ∀ k : ι, IsAffine (Z.etaleForget.obj (T k)) ∧ IsNoetherianRing Γ(Z.etaleForget.obj (T k), ⊤) ∧ Module.Finite Γ(Z.etaleForget.obj (T k), ⊤) (F.val.obj (op (T k)))) [HasDerivedCategory.{v} Z.SmallModules] [HasDerivedCategory.{v} (schemeSpace (Over.mk (𝟙 Y))).SmallModules] (q : ℤ) (hq : (d : ℤ) < q) : IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (schemeSpace (Over.mk (𝟙 Y))).SmallModules q).obj ((derivedDirectImage p).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor Z.SmallModules 0).obj (Z.smallModuleRestriction.obj F))))
lean.note: Coherence is quasi-coherence plus finite generation on one jointly surjective Noetherian affine etale cover; an affine chart is canonically Spec of its global sections. Geometric fibres are literal presheaf pullbacks tested on every affine etale chart. The existing small ringed-model equivalence and canonical derived direct image compute higher module direct images without a coefficient lift. Added only the three already-landed definition owners needed for the representable scheme target and canonical derived module operations.
